title: Condensation, forcing preservation, and larger cardinals
details: Develop condensation and its GCH consequences, the separate diamond-in-L construction, cardinal-preserving and iterated forcing, symmetric models, and large-cardinal ultrapowers as set-theory continuations. Ultrapowers at a measurable cardinal require a complete measure and a separate well-foundedness argument. The basic constructible inner model and generic-extension foundation do not supply these advanced proofs or independence witnesses.
